settings.heading: Questions & Policies
settings.text: Everything you need to know before you reserve.

settings.question: What's included?
settings.answer: Four days of instruction from 8 pro instructors, classroom and field sessions, lodging in heated log cabins, family-style meals, and The Hunter's Gathering field kit (over $400 value).

settings.question: How does the payment plan work, and when is the balance due?
settings.answer: Reserve with a $350 deposit today. The remaining $1,445 is split into 3 automatic payments of $481.67, with the final payment due March 15, 2027. You can also pay the full $1,795 at checkout.

settings.question: What's your cancellation, refund and transfer policy?
settings.answer: [Confirm with Asha] Your seat is transferable to another hunter at any time. Add refund and cancellation terms here once decided.

settings.question: What are the cabins and lodging like?
settings.answer: You'll stay in heated log cabins at Cascades Camp & Conference Center in Yelm, WA. Cabins are shared with other attendees. [Confirm with Asha] Add how many people per cabin and what bedding is provided.

settings.question: Do I need to be an experienced hunter?
settings.answer: No. Sessions are built for both new and seasoned hunters. Whether you're filling your first tag or chasing a record-class animal, you'll leave with tactics you can use this season.

settings.question: What should I bring?
settings.answer: [Confirm with Asha] Add the packing list (field clothing, boots, rain gear, notebook, etc.). The full list will also be in the 2027 Event Guide.

settings.question: I'm flying in. What's the nearest airport?
settings.answer: Seattle-Tacoma International (SEA) is about one hour away. Portland International (PDX) is about two hours away. [Confirm with Asha] Add whether shuttle or carpool options are available.

settings.question: Can I come by myself?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Many hunters come solo and leave with mentors, hunting partners and lifelong friends. Meals, campfires and shared cabins make it easy to meet people.

settings.question: Can my spouse, kids or partner attend?
settings.answer: [Confirm with Asha] Add whether guests can attend, any age minimum, and pricing for family groups. Family groups save $100 with a code at checkout.

settings.title: Success Is No Accident
settings.description: Dave Riley, the Blacktail Coach, shares field-tested tactics for hunters on this weekly podcast. Whether you're a seasoned hunter or just getting started, we'll help you turn preparation into achievement and passion into results.

settings.description: Join us for an exciting adventure where we explore field-tested tactics that enhance the skills of both novice and experienced hunters, with hunter training and mentorship from Heather.

settings.title: Talking Turkey with Alex Chaney
settings.description: We dig into field-tested turkey tactics every hunter should know, and why mentorship helps new hunters refine their skills.
